issues.explanation: The proposed preferred_fa «مخاطرهٔ باقی‌مانده» is a singular form with ezafe, but what INSO 23733 clause 6.5.2 actually prints is the plural «مخاطره‌های باقی‌مانده». Rule 1 requires the preferred to equal the printed form; the printed form is currently demoted to alternatives_fa, which inverts the hierarchy.
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) swap: make preferred_fa «مخاطره‌های باقی‌مانده» (the printed form) and list the singular as an alternative; or (b) if editorial convention requires a singular headword, add an explicit note to the editor_note_fa: «مفرد تدوینی است؛ استاندارد صرفاً شکل جمع را در بند ۶.۵.۲ چاپ کرده و تعریف مستقلی ندارد.»

issues.explanation: The editor note asserts that «نظارت» is the official INSO 23682 clause 3.2.1 term for 'oversight' — the stated grounds for its removal from alternatives — but no printed evidence for that clause appears in this entry's printed_evidence array. The preferred term and definition are correct; the removal justification is plausible but unverifiable from the supplied evidence.
issues.suggested_fix: Add INSO 23682 clause 3.2.1 to printed_evidence, or mark the cross-reference as «در انتظار تأیید».

issues.explanation: The alias «راهبری» is listed without any editorial justification. The editor note explains why «حاکمیت» is retained but is silent on «راهبری». In INSO and ISO/IEC Persian adoptions, «راهبری» appears in contexts associated with leadership or strategic direction — concepts distinct from governance. If any INSO standard prints «راهبری» for a different defined concept, its inclusion here violates Rule 1.
issues.suggested_fix: Either add a note explaining why «راهبری» does not conflict with any INSO-defined concept in the series, or remove it from alternatives_fa pending that verification.

issues.explanation: The editor note correctly flags that INSO 42001 uses «انطباق» also for 'conformity' (a distinct concept), but this homonym warning is confined to the editor note and absent from definition_fa. Per Rule 2, scope and attribution distinctions must be surfaced in the entry itself; readers who do not read editor notes will see only a single «انطباق» definition with no indication of the dual use.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a disambiguation note directly in definition_fa, for example: «یادداشت: در INSO 42001، «انطباق» همچنین برای conformity (تطابق با الزامات) به‌کار می‌رود که مفهومی جداست.»
